findings.title: /autopilot/stop NOT Refactored — Phase 0 Workflows Survive User Stop
findings.failure_sequence: User starts pipeline -> Phase 0 launches with definition_id=autopilot-phase0 -> User clicks Stop -> stop_pipeline queries filter_by(definition_id=autopilot) -> Phase 0 NOT found -> Phase 0 continues running and spending tokens
findings.fix: Replace inline pause logic with _pause_project_workflows(db, project_id, paused_by='user')
findings.impact: Real financial loss. Phase 0 continues consuming LLM tokens after user clicks Stop.

findings.title: _run_one_feature Budget Guard Uses Separate DB Session — Race Condition
findings.requirement_violated: Architecture specified use existing DB session
findings.failure_sequence: _run_one_feature opens get_db() at line ~7020 -> Budget guard opens SECOND get_db() at line ~7119 -> Between sessions, another thread records costs and triggers budget enforcement -> Session B reads stale cost data -> Budget guard returns True -> New workflow launched despite over-budget project
findings.fix: Reuse the existing db session from the earlier context block
findings.impact: Under concurrent feature pipelines, new workflows can launch after budget is exceeded.

findings.title: _pause_project_workflows Missing 'starting' Agent Status
findings.failure_sequence: Agent spawned in starting state -> Budget exceeded -> _pause_project_workflows filters Agent.status.in_(['working', 'idle']) -> starting agent excluded -> Agent transitions to working -> Continues spending past budget

findings.title: Misleading Log Messages for Generalized paused_by Guards
findings.failure_sequence: Budget enforcement pauses workflow with paused_by=budget -> Self-heal guard correctly skips it -> Log says 'is user-paused' -> Operator confused about why pipeline stalled
findings.fix: Change log messages to include actual paused_by value

findings.title: User-Paused Workflows Preserve Stale status_reason
findings.failure_sequence: Project over budget -> status_reason set to 'Budget limit reached' -> User pauses via /autopilot/stop -> paused_by changes to 'user' -> status_reason remains 'Budget limit reached' -> UI shows misleading message

findings.title: OpenRouter Direct Costs Without Entity Links Bypass Budget Enforcement
findings.failure_sequence: External caller posts cost with workflow_id=None and task_id=None -> CostEntry created in ledger -> No derivation rollup triggered -> No budget enforcement fires -> Actual spend exceeds reported cost_total_usd
findings.fix: Require at least one of task_id/workflow_id, or route unlinked costs through fallback derivation

findings.title: Tests Use Source Inspection Instead of Behavioral Assertions
findings.fix: Replace source inspection tests with behavioral tests that verify actual blocking behavior

findings.title: _extract_session_id Fragile Tmux Name Parsing
findings.fix: Store session_id explicitly in Agent model rather than parsing from tmux name
